script_text: Cancer, your Moon-ruled Water heart faces a sudden clash threatening both love and money. Early week, the Moon squares Mars in your 10th House Monday, sparking career friction with bosses. Tuesday worsens as Mercury squares your 2nd House, tempting a risky money choice. Wednesday lifts as Venus trines your 7th House, opening honest love conversation and healing suspicion. Mid-week, Jupiter trines your Moon from your 5th House, boosting romantic confidence. Late week, Mars enters your 1st House opposing Jupiter, causing impulsive spending and blunt, regrettable words. Sunday, the Moon conjoins Saturn in your 9th House, demanding patience with family plans and travel delays. Wednesday is best because Venus trines your 7th House, deepening love. Monday is worst because the Moon squares Mars in your 10th House. Weekly advice: write your feelings first before replying, protecting money and partnerships this week. Follow for your daily updates.
